text:
cs-jordan: BrightCart hit a spike at 09:05 UTC, customers saw 503s. They say Dedicated pool didn't scale quickly enough — prolonged 30s tail. Logs show a bunch of ImagePullBackOffs + a couple of auth 403s from our registry. Raising to support for triage. :rotating_light:

ops-bot: created incident INC-2026-4082 for BrightCart surge (priority: P2)

ashwin: ok, can you paste the minimal repro steps and last 1m of events? also which dedicated pool and tenant?

cs-jordan: tenant=brightcart-prod, pool=dedicated-eu-west-1-g2. Repro is just their nightly batch + a marketing spike — high QPS. I pulled these from their environment: `kubectl get pods -n brightcart-prod` and `kubectl get events -n brightcart-prod --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp | tail -n 40`

maya: quick paste of the top events (sanitized):
```
Warning  Failed     2s   kubelet, node-7  Failed to pull image "registry.redwood:443/brightcart/worker:sha-abc" 403 Unauthorized
Warning  BackOff    1s   kubelet, node-7  Back-off pulling image "registry.redwood:443/brightcart/worker:sha-abc"
Normal   Pulling    0s   kubelet, node-8  Pulling image "registry.redwood:443/brightcart/worker:sha-abc"
Warning  FailedScheduling 0s  default-scheduler  0/5 nodes are available: 1 Insufficient cpu, 2 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate
```

maya: so two issues showing up together: registry 403s (auth) and a temporary scheduler fit problem where nodes reported low allocatable cpu during the spike. That explains delayed spin-up + pods stuck pulling images.

lina: fwiw infra deployed a registry token rotation last night with shorter TTL for CI tokens. If pre-pulled images used older token, it could 403. Also noisy neighbor noise (large inference jobs) has been observed on node-7 recently, causing CPU steal and fake "Insufficient cpu" while kube tries to pack pods.

ashwin: good catch. For immediate mitigation: 1) bump minReplicas on the HPA for brightcart-worker to 2 (they were at 0->1 scaling path) 2) add a temporary warmpool preroll to pre-pull the image on dedicated nodes 3) add a fallback to hosted-model variant if attach fails

maya: I just patched HPA: `kubectl patch hpa brightcart-worker -n brightcart-prod -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'` — will monitor. also triggered a manual daemonset job to pre-pull the image on the dedicated pool.

cs-jordan: thanks — customer confirmed 503 rate dropped immediately after pre-pulls started coming up, but still saw a couple of 429s during the tail. They want a root cause doc.

lina: action items:
- infra: revert/adjust token rotation window for registry tokens used by dedicated pools OR add server-side token refresh shim (assigned to infra-team)
- eng-platform: add probe to detect when image pulls fail with 403 and auto-retry using service-account refresh (assigned to @ashwin)
- support/CS: notify BrightCart of short-term increases and next steps (assigned to cs-jordan)

ashwin: one more note — scheduler "Insufficient cpu" can be due to noisy-tenant pods occupying CPU but not reporting correct resource requests (misconfigured burstable jobs). I'll look at node metrics and the noisy tenant's pods on node-7. If we see consistent steal, we should update eviction/taint policy or isolate noisy jobs to a different pool.

maya: logs snippet from node-7 top (1m avg): `kubelet: cpu% 89, system% 40, kube-reserved 0.0` — pointing to heavy host CPU.

ops-bot: updated incident INC-2026-4082 with mitigations and assigned owners (infra-team, eng-platform, cs-team)

cs-jordan: customer asked for ETA on registry fix — can infra give a timeline?

lina: infra will roll back the token TTL change tomorrow morning CET and put a guard to avoid token TTL < 2h for tenant warmpools. ETA 36h including tests.

ashwin: for the postmortem I'll add repro steps: run a synthetic spike that forces HPA scale from 0->1 while simultaneously rotating registry tokens and scheduling noisy inference load on node-7. That reproduces the compound failure (imagepull 403 + scheduler fit).

maya: marking thread for follow-up, will close incident once token TTL revert is live and warmpool pre-pull automation is in place. :white_check_mark:
